subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Must the reported race be encoded in the deterministic native replay harness before implementation, or is the supplied shipped Gateway trace sufficient to begin the bounded reconciliation repair?
rationale: The failure evidence is strong, but this shared state boundary combines history replacement, live events, provisional messages, tools, outbox state, and reconnect ownership; maintainer intent is needed on the required pre-change proof threshold.

options.title: Require deterministic replay first
options.body: Encode overlapping delayed `chat.history` completions through the real shared view model, then repair the invariant against that executable reproduction.

options.title: Accept the live trace
options.body: Implement from the supplied Gateway trace and require focused Swift coverage plus device or simulator proof before landing.

recommendation.title: Require deterministic replay first
recommendation.body: Encode overlapping delayed `chat.history` completions through the real shared view model, then repair the invariant against that executable reproduction.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns native chat generation ordering, reconnect behavior, history refreshes, and the deterministic convergence direction.
